chapters.label: Munich, live
chapters.text: Munich, 2024. Spain, in red, are losing to France in the Euro semi-final. Sixteen-year-old Lamine Yamal gets the ball outside the box. A defender blocks his way. One step inside... he shoots... off the post! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. He opens his body and wraps his left foot round the ball. It swerves around the defender toward the far post.

chapters.label: The far post
chapters.text: From behind: past Maignan's dive, in off the post! The youngest scorer in Euro history!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: open your body, and curl it around the defender toward the far post.
